Mission Local reported that three friends arrived at the Mission Street GameStop at 6 a.m. to buy the new Zelda game. About 10 other gamers joined the line over the next three hours, and the friends secured the first three spots for the collector’s edition. Mike Carrillo was first to purchase the game at 10 a.m.
